items.name: Jumping Jacks
items.description: A classic cardio move that raises your heart rate and warms the whole body.
items.setup: Stand tall with feet together and arms by your sides.
steps: Jump your feet out to slightly wider than shoulder-width while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start, bringing your arms down.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm.
items.breathing: Breathe in a steady rhythm rather than in short gasps.
mistakes: Letting the arms flop without control.
items.easier: Do Step Jacks, stepping one foot out at a time.
items.harder: Increase the pace, or sink into a small squat each time the feet land wide.
cautions: High impact: choose Step Jacks if jumping is uncomfortable.
Wear supportive shoes on hard floors.

items.name: Step Jacks
items.description: A low-impact version of jumping jacks: step out one foot at a time while raising the arms.
items.setup: Stand tall with feet together and arms by your sides.
steps: Step your right foot out to the side while raising both arms overhead.
Step it back in as your arms come down.
Repeat with the left foot.
Pick up the pace as you warm up while staying in control.
items.breathing: Breathe steadily in rhythm with your steps.
mistakes: Shuffling without fully raising the arms.
Stepping out so far that you lose balance.
items.easier: Raise the arms only to shoulder height.
items.harder: Move faster, or progress to Jumping Jacks.
cautions: Make sure there is enough space around you to raise your arms.

items.name: High Knees
items.description: Running in place with the knees driving up raises the heart rate and works the hip flexors.
items.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart and arms bent at your sides.
steps: Run in place, driving one knee up toward hip height.
Switch legs quickly, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms in time with your legs.
Keep your chest up and your core braced.
items.breathing: Breathe quickly but rhythmically, and slow down if you cannot catch your breath.
mistakes: Letting the knee lift drop very low as you tire.
items.easier: Do Standing Knee Drives at a marching pace without jumping.
items.harder: Increase the speed while keeping the knees high.
cautions: High impact: choose the marching version if your joints feel uncomfortable.

items.name: Standing Knee Drive
items.description: A brisk, low-impact march with powerful knee drives and arm swings.
items.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms bent at 90 degrees.
steps: Drive one knee up toward hip height while swinging the opposite arm forward.
Lower that foot and immediately drive the other knee up.
Keep a brisk pace with no jumping.
Stay tall and keep your core engaged.
items.breathing: Breathe steadily; you should be working but still able to speak in short phrases.
mistakes: Stomping instead of placing the feet softly.
items.easier: Slow the pace and lift the knees lower.
items.harder: Rise onto the toes of the standing foot with each knee drive.
cautions: Hold onto a chair if you need help with balance.

items.name: Butt Kicks
items.description: Jog in place while bringing your heels toward your glutes to lift your heart rate.
items.setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
steps: Start jogging in place.
Flick each heel back toward your glutes.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your knees pointing down.
Move your arms naturally.
items.easier: Walk in place and lift each heel slowly without jogging.
cautions: Impact: choose the walking version if jogging is uncomfortable.

items.name: Skater Hops
items.description: Sideways leaps from one foot to the other, like a speed skater, for power and balance.
items.setup: Stand on your right leg with a slight bend in the knee and your left foot lifted behind you.
steps: Leap sideways to the left, landing softly on your left foot.
Swing your right leg behind you and reach your arms across your body for balance.
Pause briefly to steady yourself.
Leap back to the right and keep alternating.
items.breathing: Breathe in a steady rhythm, breathing out as you push off.
mistakes: Letting the knee collapse inward on landing.
Leaping further than you can control.
items.easier: Do Skater Steps without the jump.
items.harder: Increase the distance or pace while still landing softly.
cautions: High impact and demanding on balance: clear the area and use a non-slip floor.

items.name: Skater Steps
items.description: A low-impact skater: step side to side and tap the trailing foot behind you.
items.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
steps: Step your right foot wide to the right.
Sweep your left foot behind your right and tap the toes down, bending the right knee slightly.
Step back to the left and repeat with the opposite leg.
Swing your arms across your body to keep a rhythm.
mistakes: Taking steps that are too narrow.
Letting the standing knee cave in.
items.easier: Make the steps smaller and slower.
items.harder: Sink lower with each step, or move faster.

items.name: Mountain Climber
items.description: Driving the knees toward the chest from a plank – a core and cardio exercise in one.
items.setup: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and your body in a straight line.
steps: Brace your core.
Drive your right knee toward your chest.
Switch legs quickly, bringing the left knee in as the right leg returns.
Keep your hips low and your shoulders over your wrists.
items.breathing: Breathe in a steady rhythm and do not hold your breath.
mistakes: Letting the shoulders drift behind the hands.
Moving faster than you can control.
items.easier: Step the knees in slowly one at a time, or place your hands on a sturdy chair seat.
items.harder: Increase the pace while keeping the hips steady.
cautions: Use fists if your wrists are uncomfortable.

items.name: Shadow Boxing
items.description: Light, rhythmic punches with soft, bouncy knees – a fun, low-impact way to raise your heart rate.
items.setup: Stand in a staggered stance with knees soft, fists up near your chin and elbows tucked in.
steps: Punch forward with one arm, rotating slightly through your torso.
Pull the hand back to your chin quickly.
Alternate arms, mixing straight punches and hooks.
Stay light on your feet and keep moving.
items.breathing: Breathe out sharply with each punch.
mistakes: Snapping the elbow straight at full extension.
items.easier: Punch slowly with your feet planted.
items.harder: Speed up, and add squats or side steps.
cautions: Keep a slight bend in the elbow at the end of each punch.

items.name: Side Step Touch
items.description: A simple side-to-side step that gets you moving gently – ideal as a warm-up or a light cardio block.
items.setup: Stand with feet together and knees soft.
steps: Step your right foot out to the side.
Bring your left foot in to touch beside it.
Step back to the left and tap the right foot in.
Add arm swings or claps to raise the intensity.
items.breathing: Breathe easily; you should be able to talk.
mistakes: Taking steps too small to raise the heart rate.
items.easier: Keep the steps small and the arms relaxed.
items.harder: Take wider steps, bend the knees more, and add overhead arm reaches.
cautions: Clear the space around you before you start.
